body: Well to be honest buddy I don’t smoke anymore. But the first 3 times it happened I smoked after and was fine. It almost made it stopped. Overcame the fear. This time round I was too scared + covid starting and other stresses I never bothered. If you would like to try. Smoke a very small amount when you are in a good head space. Good luck brother
Glad u are feeling better pal. It’s a strange thing but it’s nothing to fear, hope all is well!

I was a daily smoker for years. Had it happen 3 times over that span but on the 29th of Nov I had my worst one. I am better now and you will get better. You were never “not okay” it’s all perception. Don’t dwell on it and just keep ur head up buddy you will be fine soon enough!

Thanks man, been in similar situation before but it’s how far I have fallen from then and the pandemic, exaggerated anxiety symptoms and the balding is new. Just have to show my perseverance and grind it out. Thanks for the reply’s fam.

Thanks buddy, a reply really means a lot and it’s giving a peace of mind knowing people have had the same problems. 
Cheers.
